html:
Mahathir Mohamad was prime minister of Malaysia from 1981 to 2003 and again from 2018 to 2020. A doctor from Kedah, he led the drive to turn Malaysia into an industrial country.

He promoted a national car, Proton, heavy industry and a Look East policy that took Japan and South Korea as models. The Petronas Towers and the new capital of Putrajaya stood for his ambitions. In the 1997 Asian financial crisis he defied the IMF and imposed capital controls.

In 1998 he sacked and jailed his deputy Anwar Ibrahim, sparking the Reformasi protests. At 92 he returned as opposition leader and won the 2018 election, ending the UMNO-led coalition's 61-year rule.
sum: Mahathir Mohamad was prime minister of Malaysia from 1981 to 2003 and again from 2018 to 2020. A doctor from Kedah, he led the drive to turn Malaysia into an industrial country.
